title: Return a retryable status for the review-input mailbox-unavailable refusal
outcome: [identity-mailbox-unavailable], a transient refusal whose next step is to submit again, is returned as 429 (or 503) like the other transient identity refusals, not 409 Conflict.
acceptance: A mailbox read failure during a read-only reviewer's submission returns a retryable status (429 or 503) with [identity-mailbox-unavailable]; the fault-injection test of w-4a214468978d asserts that status.
